caption:
Under-sink cabinets have a way of turning into a junk pile fast.

Open yours and you're digging past sponges, three half-empty bottles of the same cleaner, and something you haven't touched in over a year.

A Simple Houseware 2-tier chrome sliding basket organizer gives each item its own spot. It sets directly on the cabinet floor with no installation, and each basket slides out so you're not reaching over everything else.

You can see what's there at a glance instead of digging for it — and an empty slot tells you when you're out, not a buried bottle. $34.97.
